label: Figure 5.6: The supply of laptops
alt: Two parallel supply curves for laptops, S1 to the left of S, with two leftward arrows and dashed lines showing quantity supplied falling from Q to Q1 at price P.
caption: A rise in the rent for factory space raises the costs of a large laptop maker, so at the existing price P it supplies less (Q<sub>1</sub> instead of Q). The whole curve shifts left from S to S<sub>1</sub>; a leftward shift means less is supplied at every price, and a rightward shift means more.
